svg.title: Closing a cash shift
svg.desc: 1. The cashier counts the drawer by denomination. 2. The server compares the count with expected cash from cash sales, cash in and cash out. 3. Closing is refused while a purchase in the shift still lacks a receipt photo, or while open orders are not acknowledged. 4. A shortage becomes a record against that cashier to be repaid or written off. 5. The next cashier opens with a count, and any difference from the last close must be explained.
